review.notes: Claude, session claude-4ePRiC. Independent review after FIX-PKG-MotivesAndAlgebraicCycles~adv2; I did not write the package or any of its fixes. Earlier findings: R1 (real torsion descent) and R2 (primitive heights) stay closed, and the Layer 7 mathematics is unchanged since the codex2 review (this review changes one word there). R3 is closed: sections 4.1-4.10 state finite correspondences, transfer presheaves and their tensor, Nisnevich transfer sheaves, Suslin and Tate complexes, boundary Picard and standard-triple excision, strict homotopy invariance and Gersten resolutions, bounded-above and unbounded effective localization, Bloch complexes with moving, localization and transfers, cancellation, and exact cdh pullback with the complex comparison. Each is an own target with a locator and at least three Checks (82 new, 442 in total over 87 subsections), and sections 4.11-4.20 and 5.8 consume them. Supplier order: SchemeAndStackFoundations, EtaleDualityAndPerverseSheaves, ComplexComparisonPartII, SchemeKTheoryOperations and the Tau Ceti suppliers do not depend on this roadmap. MotivicEtaleKTheory and PeriodsAndSpecialValues appear only as consumers, and HodgeStructuresPartII is not cited. The accepted packets (MC.4, MC.5, base, Part II) still request MotivicEtaleKTheory M.4/M.5a, MC.7 cites PeriodsAndSpecialValues PS.6, and data/atlas.json has the edges M.4->MC.4 and M.5a->MC.4. These are stale plan data for the maintainer, not README defects. Generality: arbitrary fields and coefficient rings for the constructions; perfectness only for strict invariance, the local-complex criterion, the bounded-above comparison and cancellation; resolution only for cdh. Corrected in place: (1) section 0.7 low-degree hypersurfaces now hold over every algebraically closed field (the contact-line and Jacobian-divisibility proof is characteristic-free), with a new Check; (2) section 2.4 now says any ground field with characteristic-zero coefficients, as the plan states; (3) sections 4.3 and the Mathlib contract now name MayerVietorisSquare, its SheafCondition and sequence_exact, Sheaf.H/H' and GrothendieckTopology.Point; (4) wrong locators fixed: Stacks Definition 7.3/0FGV (not 7.1), HMS 2014 B.7-B.8 pp.17-18, HM 2017 Theorem 9.2.22/Corollary 9.2.23, MVW Exercises 1.10-1.13, Porism 11.18, pp.100-102, 101/106, 103-106, 109, Lemma 6.2, Cisinski-Deglise Proposition 5.2.38/Corollary 5.2.39 and paragraph 11.1.2, Cancellation Proposition 3.1/Lemmas 3.2-3.3/Corollary 3.4; (5) future-tense 'will' and 'later' wording made timeless. Sources: MVW (about 80 numbered statements of the new sections), Voevodsky's Cancellation, Levine's Techniques, Suslin-Voevodsky, Friedlander-Voevodsky and Cisinski-Deglise read for the new sections, plus a seeded sample of six other sections. Suggested.lean is unchanged: one import Mathlib plus three used Tau Ceti modules, four real-bodied definitions, five theorem signatures checked by hand, eight proved examples, no sorry'd data, no set_option, no algorithms. lean-check exited 0 with exactly five 'declaration uses sorry' warnings. No Tate's-thesis theorem appears. metadata.toml is topic = "math.AG". intake check-files reports 0 problems. The README is 269 KB, within the shape rule that supersedes the old 200 KB limit.
